def isNumber(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if not s:
        return False
    
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    
    # Check for sign
    if s[i] in "+-":
        i += 1
    
    # Check for digits before decimal point
    has_digit = False
    while i < n and s[i].isdigit():
        i += 1
        has_digit = True
    
    # Check for decimal point
    if i < n and s[i] == '.':
        i += 1
        # Check for digits after decimal point
        while i < n and s[i].isdigit():
            i += 1
            has_digit = True
    
    # Check for exponent
    if i < n and s[i] in "eE":
        i += 1
        # Check for sign after exponent
        if i < n and s[i] in "+-":
            i += 1
        # Check for digits after exponent
        has_exponent_digit = False
        while i < n and s[i].isdigit():
            i += 1
            has_exponent_digit = True
        if not has_exponent_digit:
            return False
